correctness.rationale: In the pinned directed ring, follower dynamics split into nilpotent lower-shift path blocks with Hurwitz drift -I+rho T. The squared impulse-response integral gives exact stationary variance Phi_rho(ell)=1/2 sum_(h<ell)(ell-h) binom(2h,h)rho^(2h)/4^h. Strict positive second differences 1/2 C_(ell+1)rho^(2ell+2) for all 0<rho<=1 prove the balanced-gap exclusive optimizer and count n/k*binom(k,r), including k=n. The critical identity Phi_1(ell)=ell(2ell+1)C_ell/3 follows from central-binomial recurrences. The n(1-rho_n)->c fixed-k integral uses dominated Riemann sums with an integrable u^-1/2 singularity, and the n(1-rho_n)->infinity regime uses the exact generating function and a uniform truncated-tail inequality. Checked the proof boundaries rho=0 excluded and fixed k assumption. Independently solved Lyapunov blocks via exact rationals and exhaustively compared k-subsets for 2<=n<=8 at rho=1,2/3. Those finite checks corroborate but do not prove asymptotics.
